description:
Roider Union

Download v2.3.1

Save compatibility: v2.2.0 or later

Requires

LazyLib

Requires

MagicLib

Requires

RetroLib

Supports

GraphicsLib

| Supports

Nexerelin

Supports

Commissioned Crews

Supports

Second in Command

- Roaming XO

Both a culture and a profession, most roiders (roaming asteroid miners) live as nomads, travelling the Sector in their ships to find mining sites. When many of them allied with their more sedentary kin to fight a massive surge of piracy, no one expected it to last. Since then, the Roider Union has become the face of all roiders in the public eye and a minor power in its own right.

Features:

- Join the Roider Union, an alliance of asteroid miners

- Retrofits! Convert your junk civilian ships into warships

- Find refuge in the far reaches at independent roider stations

Battlestation[close]

Gameplay Tips:

- Roiders rely heavily on their fighters. Use the Fighter Clamps hullmod to even bring them on your frigates!

- Ship conversions are done at markets with a Union HQ industry. Go to the bar to meet the Roider CEO in charge.

- Some Roider ships have tough armor modules on their front or sides. Low hit-strength weapons will struggle to do damage to them.

Changelog:Version 2.3.1

Bug Fixes

- Fixed Orbital Station variant IDs

Version 2.3.0

New Features

- Added Roider battlestation!

Changes

- Removed codex unlock requirement from most Roider ships

- Removed manufacturer names from ships - back to "Roider Union" again

- Added "military" tag to Union HQ - should now contribute to military operations in Nexerelin.

- Fighter Clamps can no longer be S-modded.

- Buffed Gambit-class cruiser

- Flux dissipation from 300 to 500

- OP from 100 to 120

- Shield efficiency from 1.2 to 1.0

- Buffed Wrecker-class cruiser

- Speed from 45 to 60

- Shield efficiency from 1.1 to 0.8

- Buffed Telamon-class battleship

- Flux dissipation from 400 to 800

- OP from 310 to 340

Bug Fixes

- Tried to fix random save break from RoiderMinerAssignmentAI when using non-standard JVM - may or may not actually work.

- Arc Zapper now correctly arcs 25% of the time instead of 75%.

Version 2.2.9

Changes

- Buffed Roaming XO's Ringer Mods fleet maneuvering bonus from +20% to +30%.

- Nerfed Roaming XO's Salvaging crew loss reduction from 75% to 50% in line with Second in Command's skill changes.

Bug Fixes

- Can no longer have your last Argos mothership convert itself into a frame hull.

- Fixed Roider Dives and Union HQ not supplying resources after loading a saved game.

Version 2.2.8

Bug Fixes

- Fixed crash when Union HQ submarket failed to initialize correctly

Version 2.2.7

Changes

- Added Shielded Cargo Holds to Basker phase destroyer

- Added Nexerelin mining strength for Rotary Hammer Launcher

- Roaming's Storm dissipation buff scales from 0% to 100% from its max range to 50% of max

- Improved Hulks' description

Bug Fixes

- Fixed crash from IndexOutOfBoundsException in NomadWarningTaggingScript

- Fixed Roaming's Rockpiper Engineers D-mod avoidance display

- Fixed Shipworks not allowing frame hulls

- Fixed Union HQ retrofit reputation requirements

- Fixed wiide Trailboss sprite

- Fixed Roider Dives' mining not working at beginning of game

- Fixed Phasenet flickering in campaign

- Fixed Garrucha Phase Draw moving off-screen Garruchas off-map

- Fixed display bug when opposing fleet has Storm skill

- Removed misplaced RetroLib setting

- Fixed error when picking nomad trade fleet source market

Version 2.2.6

Bug Fixes

- Fixed crash in NomadWarningTaggingScript

Version 2.2.5

Bug Fixes

- (Second in Command) Fixed Hulks armor and hull buffs becoming debuffs in some cases

Version 2.2.4

Bug Fixes

- Fixed codex crash

- (Second in Command) Fixed Hulks shield buff becoming a debuff in some cases

- (Second in Command) Fixed Hulks applying shield buff to shieldless NPC ships

Version 2.2.3

Bug Fixes

- Hopefully fixed crash in Hulks deployment script

Version 2.2.2

New Features

- (Second in Command) NPC fleets are able to use Hulks skill

- (Second in Command) Added (future?) tag so Roaming aptitude codex does not need to be unlocked

Changes

- (Second in Command) Replaced Storm skill's OP discount with flux buffs

- Active venting is 10% faster

- Passive dissipation is 20% faster when near enemies, depending on size of largest non-missile weapon slot

- (Second in Command) Replaced placeholder Roaming aptitude description

- Reduced how often Phasenet Tow Pattern code runs

- Enabled it for NPC fleets

Bug Fixes

- Fixed Roider Union Reformer script not being added when mod is added to a save

Version 2.2.1

New Features

- (Second in Command) Added Roaming logistics aptitude

- Added missing Basker retrofits

Changes

- Changed a couple NPC post names

Bug Fixes

- Fixed Roider ships playing wrong explosion/shield/etc. sound effects

- Fixed Tracker Core description

- Stopped Interdiction Sequence from targeting allies

- Added MODULE hint to armor modules

Version 2.2.0

New Features

- (Nexerelin) Added Desperado super start

- Added Basker-class phase destroyer

- Added Garrucha-class phase drone

- Added Garrucha Phase Draw hullmod

- Added two built-in Hazard MRM Autoloader weapons to Gambit-class fast cruiser

- Hazard MRMs always explode when destroyed

- Including if they have not been fired yet

- Added Arc Zapper

- Added Arc Cannon

Changes

- Buffed Calidor

- Increased speed from 40 to 50

- Increased OP from 100 to 110

- Increased cargo space from 120 to 180

- Buffed Jane's cargo space from 30 to 40

- Buffed Pile Driver

- Increased damage from 600 to 800

- Increased projectile width from 8 to 10

- Buffed Spike Driver

- Increased damage from 300 to 400

- Nerfed flux per shot from 240 to 250

- Increased projectile width from 5 to 8

- Buffed Spike Driver and Pile Driver's damage, flux efficiency, and projectile width

- Buffed Phasenet GREATLY

- In turn, Wreckers can no longer stack Phasenets on a single target

- Replaced Rocksaw's Vulcan with a Dual LMG because I hilariously miscalculated Broadsword's kinetic DPS

- Nerfed Breaker drone

- Reduced armor from 75 to 60

- Reduced hull from 400 to 300

- Nerfed Glitz drone's flare EMP damage from 400 to 100

- Nerfed Tracker's replacement time from 18 seconds to 20

- Nerfed Hopskip Mk.II's replacement time from 15 seconds to 18

- Improved Tracker Core's description - the speed buff affects fighters from the same carrier

Bug Fixes

- Rockroach can now activate Temporal Shell while Damper Field is active and vice versa

- Fixed NPE in MIDAS hullmod

- Fixed Fighter Clamps being addable to some phase ships

- Fixed crash when Roider Dives is on a market in hyperspace

- Fixed nomad bases trying to spawn when the economy doesn't exist

- Fixed NPE when trying to add null industry

- Fixed bugs with Dives/Union HQ when nothing available to mine

- Fixed highlight in Union HQ BP requirement text

- Fixed missing token replacement in Argos salvage hullmod's description

- (Nexerelin) Fixed Roider Dives and Rockpiper Shipworks not being buildable at faction colonies you are governing

- Not sure if this actually made it into 2.1.1

Version 2.1.1

New Features

- Renamed variants to roider-style names

- Renamed Roider Union mercenary fleets with "militia" names

- Added Montauk-class heavy destroyer - an Enforcer conversion with Fortress Shield

- Added Glitz-class interceptor drone - it keeps a ring of flares around itself

- Added Glitz Switch hullmod - like Tracker Swap, it changes the built-in drones on Roider ships

- Made several internal lists editable by other mods

Changes

- Built-in Advanced Turret Gyros to Telamon to highlight its anti-small ship role

- Reduced Telamon's OP from 320 to 310, accordingly

- Widened Gambit's side hardpoint arcs from 5 to 9 degrees for comfort

- Reduced prospector fleet spawns

- Reduced Pile Driver's auxiliary front smoke puffs

Bug Fixes

- Fixed several bugs with Phasenet ship system - PULLING TOWARDS WRECKER WORKS NOW

- Fixed Roider Dives saying you need a BP when your spaceport isn't built yet

- Fixed crash when adding Converted Flight Decks to Argos

- Fixed crash when Fighter Clamps is shown on a FIGHTER-sized ship

- Fixed retrofit BPs not requiring you to know their specific source ships

- Fixed "Rock and Stone!" greeting's tokens

- (Nexerelin) Fixed Roider Dives and Rockpiper Shipworks not being buildable at faction colonies you are governing

Version 2.1.0

New Features

- Added Historical Roider Charter special item for Roider Dives and Union HQ

- Boosts production, mining range, and fleet size

- Organics are now available as void resources for Dives and Union HQ to gather

Changes

- Nerfed Calidor's Interdiction Sequence

- Reduced range from 1000 to 800

- Restarts target's engines after a few seconds

- Void resources in Roider systems are now preset

- Rebalanced void resource generation - roughly a bell curve, now

Bug Fixes

- Fixed cargo screen lag 100%

- Fixed nomad bases in fringe not accurately tracking commodity sales for shortages/surpluses

- Fixed Mad MIDAS bar event's bad result not being shown - it was still happening, though

Version 2.0.7

Bug Fixes

- Fixed initialization crash on new game

Version 2.0.6

Bug Fixes

- Fixed prospector fleets being spammed

- Fixed Union HQ submarket and retrofitting not using Roider Union rep/commission

- Fixed NPE from Rockpiper Shipworks

- Reduced lag when opening inventory - still looking for main cause

Version 2.0.5

Bug Fixes

- Fixed random Phasenet crash

- Added missing Ring Flare Launcher description

- Blocked roider prospectors from spawning in some invalid places

Version 2.0.4

New Features

- Added Ring Flare Launcher

aiDescription: Adds a new playable faction of asteroid miners who live as nomads across the sector, offering a full culture and profession system. Players can join the Roider Union, convert civilian ships into warships using retrofits, and access unique stations in fringe systems. The mod includes new ships, weapons, hullmods, and support for major mods like Nexerelin and Second in Command.
